readings: For each film rating, compute the average replacement_cost over the films with that rating. Also compute the average, over those films, of each film's own per-day rental price (rental_rate divided by rental_duration). Then give the ratio of each rating's average per-day price to the plain mean of those per-rating averages across the 5 ratings, with each rating counted once. Leave the numbers unrounded.

For each film rating, compute the average replacement_cost over the films with that rating. Also compute that rating's per-day rental price as the rating's average rental_rate divided by its average rental_duration (a ratio of averages, not an average of per-film ratios). Then give the ratio of each rating's per-day price to the plain mean of those per-rating per-day prices across the 5 ratings, with each rating counted once. Leave the numbers unrounded.
queries:
WITH per_rating AS (
  SELECT rating,
         AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
         AVG(CAST(rental_rate AS REAL) / rental_duration) AS avg_per_day_price
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT rating,
       avg_replacement_cost,
       avg_per_day_price,
       avg_per_day_price / (SELECT AVG(avg_per_day_price) FROM per_rating) AS ratio
FROM per_rating;
WITH r AS (
  SELECT rating,
         AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
         AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS per_day_price
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT rating,
       avg_replacement_cost,
       per_day_price,
       per_day_price / (SELECT AVG(per_day_price) FROM r) AS ratio_to_mean
FROM r;
